meta.name: datamol
meta.description: Pythonic wrapper around RDKit with simplified interface and sensible defaults. Preferred for standard drug discovery including SMILES parsing, standardization, descriptors, fingerprints, clustering, 3D conformers, parallel processing. Returns native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects. For advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 处理化学分子数据，计算描述符和指纹。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在药物发现中处理分子结构并计算属性。
copy.tagline_en: Process chemical molecular data, compute descriptors and fingerprints.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle molecular structures and compute properties in drug discovery.

howto.what: 当你提出分子或药物相关请求时，Claude 会用 datamol 解析并标准化 SMILES 等结构，计算描述符与指纹，做聚类、3D 构象等分析，返回 RDKit 分子对象；需要自定义高级参数时直接改用 RDKit。
howto.when: 当用户要求解析 SMILES、计算分子性质、生成指纹等常规药物发现分析时触发；若需精细控制自定义参数，则直接改用 RDKit。

say.text: 帮我解析这串 SMILES 并标准化，输出规范结构。
say.note: Claude 会用 datamol 解析并清洗分子。

say.text: 计算这批分子的描述符，筛选符合类药五规则的。
say.note: 返回分子量、LogP 等属性并筛出候选。

say.text: 用 Butina 聚类这批分子，挑出 50 个多样性代表。
say.note: 按 Tanimoto 距离分组并选出代表分子。

howto.what_en: Claude will use datamol for molecular tasks: parse/standardize SMILES, compute descriptors and fingerprints, cluster, generate 3D conformers, etc., returning native RDKit Mol objects. For custom parameters, it uses RDKit directly.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to parse SMILES, compute properties, generate fingerprints, or do other standard drug-discovery analysis. For fine-grained custom parameters, Claude uses RDKit instead.

say_en.text: Parse this SMILES and standardize it, output the canonical structure.
say_en.note: Claude uses datamol to parse and clean it.

say_en.text: Compute descriptors for this batch and filter by Lipinski's rule of five.
Butina-cluster these molecules and pick 50 diverse representatives.
say_en.note: Groups by Tanimoto distance and selects reps.
